results.title: HC refuses to interfere with criminal proceedings against doc
results.description: While the petitioner-doctor claimed that the minor’s age at the time of abortion was stated to be 20 years and she consented to the procedure, Justice Purushaindra Kumar Kaurav underscored that under the law, age has to be “ascertained and recorded”, and “not merely accepted on an unverified oral representation”.
